rb Miramar, our signature printing technique, creates the illusion of denim on any fabric.
If you love our Dahlia Flare Jean, try this version for all-day polish and comfort, whether heading to dinner from your desk or traveling through the airport. They're cut with a mid rise, fitted thigh, and a flared hem that gradually widens from the knee. Functional components, including a zip fly, button closure, and belt loops, combine with a trompe l'oeil wash and other hyperrealistic details.
